summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — WKL.AS +10%, ULVR.L +8%, UNA.AS +7%, CAP.PA +6%, G24.DE +6%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (PHIA.AS -9%, IFX.DE -8%, BARC.L -7%, ENR.DE -7%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: WKL.AS (+9.57%) — No single fresh catalyst pinpointed for 2026-07-29; move looks like continuation/acceleration of a 3-week AI-re-rating rally sparked by JPMorgan's Jul 9 upgrade to Overweight (PT €87, 'AI moat' thesis) plus ongoing buyback support. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — WKL.AS is a large-cap Dutch info-services/software compounder (AEX-listed, historically low beta), a profile the uk-eu momentum universe likely screens out in favor of higher-beta, higher-volume names.

top_movers.catalyst: No single fresh catalyst pinpointed for 2026-07-29; move looks like continuation/acceleration of a 3-week AI-re-rating rally sparked by JPMorgan's Jul 9 upgrade to Overweight (PT €87, 'AI moat' thesis) plus ongoing buyback support.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — WKL.AS is a large-cap Dutch info-services/software compounder (AEX-listed, historically low beta), a profile the uk-eu momentum universe likely screens out in favor of higher-beta, higher-volume names.
top_movers.suggestion: Add an analyst-rating-change trigger that admits EU large-caps into the universe for N days after a broker upgrade (e.g., JPM/GS/MS to Overweight/Buy) even if they fail the standard beta/volatility screen.

top_movers.catalyst: H1/Q2 2026 earnings beat — 5.8% Q2 sales growth, 4.8% H1 underlying sales growth, raised FY guidance; stock had its best day in years.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ULVR.L is a large-cap UK consumer-staples/household-goods name, a sector/category not covered by the bot's momentum/tech-tilted uk-eu tradable universe, so no filter ever got a chance to evaluate the earnings gap.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a consumer-staples/FTSE100-defensives sleeve to the uk-eu universe (or an earnings-day watchlist override) that admits large-cap names posting a post-results gap ≥5% at the open for same-day evaluation.

top_movers.catalyst: Q2 earnings beat: underlying sales +5.8% (vs ~4.3% est.), strongest volume growth in a decade; raised FY26 guidance to top of 4-6% range.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — UNA.AS is a mega-cap (~€120B) consumer-staples multinational, cross-listed as ULVR.L/UL/UNA.AS; uk-eu universes here likely skew to mid-cap momentum names and/or dedupe to a single primary listing, excluding the Amsterdam line entirely.
top_movers.suggestion: Add UNA.AS (or its primary ULVR.L listing) to the uk-eu large-cap staples universe, and add an earnings-gate rule that admits any universe-eligible name with a pre-market gap ≥5% on a scheduled earnings day even if normally filtered by size/sector.

top_movers.catalyst: No single discrete catalyst — 2nd day of a multi-day rally (+5.83% Mon) into July 30 H1 earnings, riding a European IT-services re-rating after SAP's cloud beat and Randstad's staffing beat.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active uk-eu strategy's universe — CAP.PA is a Euronext Paris/CAC40 large-cap IT-services name, and uk-eu universes are evidently scoped to UK-listed or specific sector lists, so even a 2-day, high-momentum breakout was never scanned.
top_movers.suggestion: Extend uk-eu universe to include CAC40/major Euronext Paris large-caps (or a pan-EU large-cap watchlist) alongside LSE names, so cross-border EU movers with multi-day momentum ≥5% get picked up pre-earnings.

top_movers.catalyst: No confirmed same-day news catalyst found; move likely reflects pre-earnings positioning (Q2 results due Aug 6, 2026), an active €350m buyback, and carryover bullish sentiment from UBS's 'buy' upgrade (Feb 2026).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: G24.DE (Scout24 SE) is a ~€5B MDAX-listed mid-cap German property-classifieds name, not a DAX40/large-cap constituent, so it was never in scope for uk-eu strategies regardless of today's move.
top_movers.suggestion: Extend the uk-eu universe to admit MDAX/SDAX mid-caps above a liquidity floor (e.g., 20D ADV > €5M) so names like G24.DE enter the scoring pipeline instead of being screened out purely by market-cap/index tier.

top_movers.catalyst: H1 2026 earnings beat: record revenue (+3.5%) and EBITDAaL (+5.0%); raised FY26 EBITDAaL growth guidance to >4% (from >3%) on MasOrange Spain deal and Africa growth.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ORA.PA is a large-cap, low-beta European telecom incumbent, a defensive sector typically excluded from momentum/mean-reversion universes tuned for higher-beta tech/growth names.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a region-wide post-earnings gap scanner (uk-eu, all sectors incl. telecom/utilities) that flags close-to-close moves ≥5% on earnings-report days, independent of existing sector/beta universe filters.

top_movers.catalyst: Q2 beat on EPS (+40% vs consensus) but shares fell as management guided Q3 margins below last year on cost inflation/mix, D&T segment margin weakness, and China procurement headwinds.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — PHIA.AS is a large-cap Dutch health-tech name on Euronext Amsterdam; likely excluded because uk-eu universes are scoped to specific sectors/indices or ADR-only coverage that doesn't pull in local-listing continental healthcare names.
top_movers.suggestion: Add Euronext Amsterdam (AEX) large-caps to the uk-eu universe filter, or specifically whitelist major EU health-tech names so an earnings-gate can catch post-results 'beat but guide-down' gaps like this one.

top_movers.catalyst: No single fresh headline today; move extends a multi-week semiconductor sector de-rating (STMicro's cautious Q3 outlook, Samsung profit-taking, auto/industrial demand worries) ahead of Infineon's own Aug 5 earnings, on an already-rich P/E (~43x).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — IFX.DE is a EUR-denominated, Xetra-listed DAX large-cap semiconductor name. The uk-eu region's strategy universes appear scoped to UK/GBP tickers or a narrow EU large-cap list that doesn't include German chip/auto-supplier names.
top_movers.suggestion: Add DAX-40 large-caps (mkt cap > €10B, avg daily volume > 1M shares) to the uk-eu universe via a EUR ticker feed, or explicitly whitelist IFX.DE given its liquidity, analyst coverage, and sector-contagion volatility profile.

top_movers.catalyst: Q2 FY26 results: profit beat (£6.1B PBT vs £5.94B est.) and raised 2026 income guidance, but EPS missed and IB/US consumer growth lagged US peers — shares fell despite the beat.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — BARC.L (UK large-cap bank, LSE-listed) isn't covered by any current universe (no UK-bank/LSE sector bucket), so no strategy could react regardless of the gap.
top_movers.suggestion: Add an LSE/UK-bank sector bucket to the universe with an earnings-gate that releases names showing a post-results gap ≥5% within 30min of open, so cross-listed large caps like BARC.L aren't structurally excluded.

top_movers.catalyst: Continuation of wind-sector selloff: GE Vernova's Jul-22 wind order/margin miss + Barclays 'peak-cycle' downgrade dragged ENR.DE through its 200-day MA into Aug-5 earnings quiet period.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — large-cap German industrial/power-equipment conglomerate (post-Siemens spin-off), a sector/geography the bot's uk-eu universe doesn't currently cover.
top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap DAX industrials (incl. ENR.DE) to the uk-eu universe with a sector-contagion trigger: flag when a same-sector peer (e.g. GE Vernova) misses guidance and correlated names gap >5% within days.
